method: Visual inspection of native Safari screenshots after navigation, swiping and device rotation.

checks.observed: Page background meets the status area without an opaque guide covering content.
Text and colored cards scroll through the viewport without opaque edge strips obscuring them.
Footer links remain visible above Safari controls and the home indicator.
Background artwork fades smoothly into the edge color; header and download badge are visible.
Header, language picker and two-column content fit the available width without horizontal clipping.

checks.state: Portrait, page top after returning from landscape
checks.observed: Page reflows correctly; header, language picker and product cards are visible without guide overlays.
